items.heading: A Salaried Job Pays
items.text: A Salaried Job Pays A Salaried Job Pays A salaried job pays the same number on the same date, whether you had a strong month or a slow one. Freelancing pays for what you closed and delivered, which means income depends on a pipeline you have to keep refilling yourself. This single difference is the real center of the freelancing vs job India debate, more than any headline about "average freelancer income.".

items.heading: Employer Pf Contribution Happens Automatically,
items.text: Employer PF contribution happens automatically, whether you remember to save or not.

items.heading: A Salaried Employee Mostly Experiences
items.text: A salaried employee mostly experiences tax through TDS deducted automatically every month and a Form 16 at year-end. Freelancing removes that automation entirely, and the paperwork gap surprises more new freelancers than the income variance does.
